steps.say: **Your classes** picks which class you are reading. It only appears when you teach more than one, and switching it reloads everything below.
Underneath sit the **measure**, the **window** the rate is computed over, and what to **compare to**. The line beneath the pickers says exactly what the current measure counts.
This is the answer: your class's pace beside the average you chose. A class with too few sessions to compare honestly says so rather than showing a number built from nothing.
steps.terminal: That's your class read as a pace rather than a pile of totals. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
